changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 2a, item 6: deleted the precomputed DispatcherConfig.runtime projection (and DispatcherRuntimeConfig), replaced by an on-demand dispatcherAgent(config, dispatcherId) accessor over agents[]; migrated server.ts, provider-diagnostics.ts, and onboard/config-files.ts to it and dropped config-files.ts's now-redundant per-dispatcher agents[] re-derivation. Deleted DispatcherStore's dead create()/upsert()/remove() and DispatcherCreateInput (zero callers). Internal-only; no persisted or published-API change.
